messages.author: 4be88a5fc86a040f
messages.subject: sendCustomMessage-toJSON pass digits parameter
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to pass a matrix through sendCustomMessage() to update highStock/highChart time series plots. 
The matrix contains a time variable in milliseconds since 1970 and a value to plot on Y-axis.

e.g.:
[[1183939200000, 40.71],
[1184025600000, 40.38],
...

sendCustomMessage() uses toJSON() to serialize data. 
By default it coerces long numbers to scientific notation and passes it as string, reducing precision and resulting in javascript error.
Is it possible to somehow override 

    .sendCustomMessage = function(type, message) {
      data <- list()
      data[[type]] <- message
      .write(toJSON(list(custom=data)))

with

    .sendCustomMessage = function(type, message, ...) {
      data <- list()
      data[[type]] <- message
      .write(toJSON(list(custom=data), ...))

to pass digits and other parameters to toJSON()? Thank you.
